comment1: Note that the database_edit_type(s) are ADD/EDIT/DELETE
comment2: When adding to the database, the edit/delete commands will default to using the ID but will also accept just a name
comment3: An error will be thrown if an EDIT/DELETE would fail if no ID was provided in an update and 2 items share the same table and name (ex: 2 spells with the same name)
comment4: On optional database fields, just leave the array entry empty, denoted simply by empty quotations
comment5: NOTE: the lists within contents are Lists OF lists. For multiple enteries within 1 entry type, just add another sublist within the overarching list
comment6: Example multientry of one type: class: [[ADD, empty, Barbarian, RAHHH], [EDIT, 2, empty, A guy who casts spells], etc...]
